arguments.title: 🧪 Add tests for handle_mmp_system
arguments.description:
🎯 What: Address testing gap for handle_mmp_system function in CancerInvasionSteppables.
📊 Coverage: Added tests for MMP secretion on fiber contact, fiber degradation at high MMP levels, no-degradation/no-secretion paths, and exception handling logic.
✨ Result: Provides confident refactoring coverage for MMP secretion and ECM fiber degradation business logic.
